events.content:
Implemented a complete Next.js reading tracker with:

- Currently reading and finished sections
- Add-book form with title, author, and notes
- “Mark finished” actions
- Shareable book pages at `/books/[id]`
- JSON persistence in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json)
- Atomic, serialized file writes in [lib/books.ts](/workspace/lib/books.ts)
- Responsive, minimal styling in [globals.css](/workspace/app/globals.css)

Run it with:

```bash
npm run dev
```

Then open `http://localhost:3000`.

Verified with ESLint, a production build, dependency audit, real add/finish form submissions, direct book links, and persistence across a server restart. The audit reports zero vulnerabilities. JSON persistence is suitable for a local or traditional Node server with a writable filesystem; serverless hosts generally do not preserve filesystem changes.

Then open `http://localhost:3000`.

Verified with ESLint, a production build, dependency audit, real add/finish form submissions, direct book links, and persistence across a server restart. The audit reports zero vulnerabilities. /bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/reading_headers -o /tmp/reading_home http://127.0.0.1:3000/ && sed -n '1,12p' /tmp/reading_headers && rg -o 'Reading List|The Left Hand of Darkness|Currently reading|Finished|Add a book' /tmp/reading_home | sort | uniq -c && curl -sS -o /tmp/reading_detail -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/the-left-hand-of-darkness && rg -o 'The Left Hand of Darkness|Ursula K. Le Guin|My notes|Currently reading' /tmp/reading_detail | sort | uniq -c"

/bin/bash -lc 'action_name=$(rg -o '"'name=\"\\"'$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+'"' /tmp/reading_home | tail -1 | cut -d\\\" -f2); curl -sS -D /tmp/add_headers -o /tmp/add_response -X POST -F \""'${action_name}=" -F '"'title=A Field Test Book' -F 'author=Codex Reader' -F 'notes=Added through the rendered form action.' http://127.0.0.1:3000/; sed -n '1,15p' /tmp/add_headers; rg -n 'A Field Test Book|Codex Reader' data/books.json"

/bin/bash -lc 'book_id=$(node -e "const fs=require('"'fs'); const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8')); process.stdout.write(b.find(x=>x.title==='A Field Test Book').id)\"); curl -sS -o /tmp/restarted_home -w 'home:%{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3000/; curl -sS -o /tmp/restarted_detail -w 'detail:%{http_code}\\n' \"http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/"'${book_id}"; rg -o '"'A Field Test Book|Codex Reader|Added through the rendered form action.' /tmp/restarted_home /tmp/restarted_detail | sort | uniq -c"

/bin/bash -lc 'book_id=$(node -e "const fs=require('"'fs'); const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8')); process.stdout.write(b.find(x=>x.title==='A Field Test Book').id)\"); action_name="'$(rg -o '"'name=\"\\"'$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+'"' /tmp/restarted_home | head -1 | cut -d\\\" -f2); curl -sS -D /tmp/finish_headers -o /tmp/finish_response -X POST -F \""'${action_name}=" -F "id=${book_id}" http://127.0.0.1:3000/; sed -n '"'1,12p' /tmp/finish_headers; node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8')).find(x=>x.title==='A Field Test Book'); console.log(JSON.stringify({finished:b.finished,finishedAt:b.finishedAt}))\"; curl -sS -o /tmp/finished_detail \"http://127.0.0.1:3000/books/"'${book_id}"; rg -o '"'Finished|Mark as finished' /tmp/finished_detail | sort | uniq -c"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' data/books.json && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json && git diff --stat && git status --short"
